coverage.text: Every requirement maps to at least one invariant, task and gate row, and every invariant appears in a task.

terminology.text: The model's words are used throughout. Windows are named the way the constitution's retraction row names them, and phase numbers appear only where existing code uses them.

contradictions-found-and-how-they-are-ca.text: Four findings: the update timing rule outside the model, a separate ticket's repair, kept unchanged here with its claim held; the consumer's R9 conflict, kept unmet by operator ruling; CG23's stale timing words, restated; and the builder's phase three documentation, restated with the change.

ambiguities-left-open.text: One remains: whether the consumer conflict holds this repair's merge or only the consumer integration claim. The parent decides it.

residuals-and-their-dispositions.text: Four residuals, each with its evidence and limit. The builder now rejects every pending request, and one unprocessable request still blocks it: a named limit. Old wording in an off-chain test name and a journey message stays, outside the fence. A request whose datum is a hash can be spent in its processing window without being folded, an exit the model does not have; it is unchanged here, shown only from source, and raised to the parent as its own story. The update timing rule outside the model has its own ticket.
